text: Check. He checks the machines every night.
Carry. She carries the boxes to the truck.
Lift. The robot lifts a car with one arm.
Fix. The engineer fixes the arm at four o'clock.
Battery. Nina checks the battery every morning.
Machine. There are nine machines on this floor.
Shift. Bolt works the night shift.
Heavy. These boxes are too heavy for me.
This is Bolt. He works here every night.
Every night? He never sleeps?
Never. He checks the machines, then he carries the boxes to the truck.
Those boxes look really heavy. Can he lift them?
He lifts two hundred kilos with one arm. But today his left arm doesn't move.
Can I fix it?
The engineer comes at four. But you can check his battery with me. Come on.
He works every night.
She checks the battery.
It carries the heavy boxes.
What does he do every day?
He never stops.

This is the night shift report. Bolt starts work at ten o'clock every night. First he checks the machines on the first floor. Then he carries the heavy boxes to the truck. He never stops and he never sleeps. At six in the morning he goes to the charging room. Nina arrives at seven. She checks Bolt's battery and she writes the report. She says Bolt is the best worker in the factory.

We have a small problem this morning. Bolt lifts the boxes with his left arm, but today the left arm does not move. It makes a strange noise, like a bird. So Bolt uses his right arm and he works very slowly. He carries one box every two minutes. Normally he carries one box every ten seconds. Please do not fix him now. The engineer arrives at four o'clock.
